answer: A decentralized network resists sybil attacks by requiring every identity to accumulate witnessed work before its voice carries weight. A new account starts at zero, with nothing granted. The protocol treats this unproven state as a faint ripple on open water: a disturbance that fades without substance. Standing grows across many epochs, each verified contribution adding weight until a small island of proven history forms. A comet of fabricated keys burns bright and vanishes. Genuine contributors build an island that persists; because weight follows witnessed tenure, they outlast any comet.
